text: The Abu Dhabi Sports Council, 'founded in 2006 by the crown prince of Abu Dhabi, Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan', is the naming sponsor of the Emirates Poules d'Essai (Emirates Poule d'Essai des Poulains and des Pouliches, 10 May 2026, ParisLongchamp) through the UAE President Cup series.
short: Abu Dhabi Sports Council names the Emirates Poules d'Essai (French Guineas)
